mining.hero-title: Enterprise AI System for Mining & Natural Resources
mining.hero-subtitle: AWS-Powered MiningOps AI Suite for Safety, Asset Reliability, and Production Efficiency
mining.solution1-desc: Computer vision at the edge for PPE/fatigue detection, proximity alerts, and incident analytics with centralized safety KPIs.
mining.solution2-desc: Condition monitoring and predictive models on vibration, temperature, pressure with maintenance workbench and alerting.
mining.solution3-desc: Cycle-time analytics, queue optimization, idle-time reduction, and dispatch insights for haulage and plant bottlenecks.
mining.solution4-desc: Dashboards for OEE, throughput, recovery, energy and emissions; drill-and-blast to mill reconciliation.
mining.solution5-desc: Automated NDVI/land disturbance layers and tailings/stockpile monitoring from Sentinel‑2 satellite data.
mining.solution6-desc: Chat-based assistant for SOP lookups, shift handover notes, and natural-language queries over KPIs and logs.
